questions.q: 六级作文评分标准与三段结构
questions.a:
## 一句话结论

六级作文 150-200 词、占 15%（106.5 分）：阅卷按**内容切题、结构清晰、语言多样、错误少**四档打分——三段式结构 + 每段一个亮点句型，稳拿 12 分档。

## 评分档位（原始 15 分制）

| 档 | 特征 |
| --- | --- |
| 13-15 | 切题、表达清楚、语言有多样性、基本无错 |
| 10-12 | 切题、结构清楚、有一些语言错误但不影响理解 |
| 7-9 | 基本切题、表达不清楚处较多 |
| 4-6 | 跑题或语言错误严重 |

## 万能三段结构

```text
第一段（40-60 词）：引入现象/名言 + 亮出观点
第二段（80-100 词）：论证 —— 2 个理由或 1 理由 + 1 例子
第三段（30-50 词）：结论 + 建议/展望
```

## 三类常考题

1. **现象议论型**：给定现象谈看法（ most frequent ）
2. **名言警句型**：解释引言含义 + 论证
3. **图表型**：描述数据 + 分析原因

## 硬规则

- 字数不足 150 词直接扣分；超 200 词浪费时间
- 卷面分段必须清晰（三段顶格）
- 不确定的高级词宁可不用——**拼写错误比用词简单更伤分**

questions.q: 六级议论文万能模板（现象议论型）
questions.a:
## 模板骨架

**第一段：引入 + 观点**

> Nowadays, ______(现象) has become increasingly common in our daily life. Opinions on this issue vary from person to person. As far as I am concerned, ______(你的立场).

**第二段：论证（理由 ×2 或理由 + 例子）**

> To begin with, ______(理由一). A good case in point is ______(例子). What's more, ______(理由二). Without ______, we would hardly be able to ______.

**第三段：结论 + 建议**

> In conclusion, ______(重申观点). Therefore, it is advisable that ______(建议，虚拟 should+原形). Only in this way can we ______(倒装展望).

## 完整示例（话题：线上学习）

> Nowadays, online learning has become increasingly common among college students. Opinions on whether it can replace traditional classrooms vary from person to person. As far as I am concerned, online learning is a valuable supplement rather than a replacement.
>
> To begin with, online courses break the limits of time and space, enabling students to learn anywhere at any time. A good case in point is the massive open online courses, which have benefited millions of learners in remote areas. What's more, traditional classrooms offer face-to-face interaction that screens can hardly reproduce; without immediate feedback from teachers, many students would struggle to stay motivated.
>
> In conclusion, the two modes of learning should complement each other. Therefore, it is advisable that students make full use of online resources while cherishing classroom interaction. Only in this way can we maximize the efficiency of learning.

## 亮点分布

每篇埋 3 个语法亮点即可：① 倒装 Only in this way can we ② 虚拟 it is advisable that...should ③ 非谓语 enabling...。**堆砌模板句反而降档**。

questions.q: 名言警句与图表作文模板
questions.a:
## 名言警句型（六级特色题型）

**第一段：解释名言**

> The well-known saying "______" conveys a profound truth: ______(用自己的话解释含义). Simple as it is, the message behind it is thought-provoking.

**第二段：论证（为什么 + 例子）**

> The reason is self-evident. ______(道理阐述). History abounds with examples: ______(名人事例，1-2 句即可).

**第三段：落实到行动**

> Accordingly, we should bear this wisdom in mind and put it into practice. Only those who ______ can truly ______.

### 示例（"Where there is a will, there is a way"）

> The well-known saying "Where there is a will, there is a way" conveys a profound truth: determination is the precondition of success. Simple as it is, the message behind it is thought-provoking.
>
> The reason is self-evident. The road to any achievement is paved with obstacles, and only strong willpower can carry us through. History abounds with examples: Edison failed thousands of times before he finally invented the electric light bulb.

## 图表型

**第一段：描述图表**

> As is vividly shown in the chart, ______(总体趋势), with the number/percentage of ______ rising/falling from ______ to ______ between ______ and ______.

**第二段：分析原因（三点）**

> What lies behind this trend? For one thing, ______. For another, ______. Last but not least, ______.

**第三段：预测 + 建议**

> The trend is likely to continue in the foreseeable future. Therefore, ______(措施), so that we can make the most of it.

## 图表描述词

上升 soar/increase dramatically · 下降 decline/drop · 平稳 remain stable/plateau · 占比 account for

questions.q: 高分替换清单：把四级表达升级为六级表达
questions.a:
## 词汇替换（左：四级 → 右：六级）

| 普通 | 升级 |
| --- | --- |
| I think | From my perspective / It is widely acknowledged that |
| important | vital / crucial / indispensable |
| very good | highly beneficial / of great value |
| very bad | undesirable / detrimental |
| more and more people | an increasing number of individuals |
| because | owing to / due to / in that |
| so | consequently / accordingly / hence |
| use | utilize / make use of / resort to |
| get | obtain / acquire / gain |
| show | demonstrate / illustrate / indicate |
| help | facilitate / be conducive to |
| solve | tackle / address / cope with |
| a lot of | a host of / numerous |
| should | be supposed to / be obliged to |

## 句式升级（四选一嵌入作文）

1. **强调句**：It is cooperation that leads to success.
2. **倒装句**：Only in this way can we solve the problem.
3. **双重否定**：No one can deny the significance of...
4. **非谓语开头**：Faced with such a situation, we should...

## 使用原则

- 一篇作文升级 **3-5 处**即可，全文高级词反而失真
- 替换必须准确：detrimental 只配坏影响，别拿它形容困难
- 拿不准的词宁可用简单词——**准确性 > 高级感**

questions.q: 段落翻译三步法：六级汉译英
questions.a:
## 一句话结论

六级翻译是**整段汉译英**（中国文化/历史/经济/社会/科技，约 180-200 个汉字，占 15%）：按"定主干 → 拆句子 → 组从句"三步走，不会的词用释义绕，绝不空句。

## 三步法

1. **通读全段**：定主题、定时态（历史→过去时；现状介绍→现在时）
2. **逐句找主干**：中文多短句堆叠、多省略主语——每句先找出"谁 + 做什么"
3. **合并组句**：中文流水句 → 英文用 which/who/介词短语/分词收编成从句结构

## 四大必用转换

| 中文特点 | 英文处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 无主句（"据报道""随着…") | It is reported that... / With the development of... |
| 流水句（一逗到底） | 拆成主句 + which/现在分词从句 |
| 动词连用（"调查、研究并解决") | 保留一个谓语，其余 to do / doing / and |
| 成语四字格（"源远流长") | 意译：has a long history（直译必错） |

## 实战例句

> 原文：造纸术是中国古代四大发明之一，对世界文明的传播起到了重要作用。

拆解：
- 句 1 主干：造纸术是发明之一 → Papermaking is one of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China
- 句 2 主干：（它）起到作用 → which has played an important role in the spread of world civilization（用 which 合并）

## 考场提醒

- 专有名词不会拼？**用上位词绕**：端午节 → a traditional Chinese festival
- 按句给分：翻译完 80% 的句子就有 80% 的分，**绝不留空句**
- 时态一致 + 主谓一致是最容易白丢的两分

questions.q: 中国特色词翻译库：考前必背 20 条
questions.a:
## 一句话结论

六级翻译十年八个主题是**中国文化、历史、经济、社会、教育、科技、旅游、环境**——把这份词库背熟，考场上直接命中。

## 高频特色词（必背）

| 中文 | 英文 |
| --- | --- |
| 改革开放 | reform and opening-up |
| 一带一路 | the Belt and Road Initiative |
| 可持续发展 | sustainable development |
| 经济全球化 | economic globalization |
| 传统文化 | traditional culture |
| 四大发明 | the Four Great Inventions |
| 脱贫攻坚 | poverty alleviation |
| 乡村振兴 | rural revitalization |
| 高铁 | high-speed railway |
| 移动支付 | mobile payment |
| 共享经济 | sharing economy |
| 电子商务 | e-commerce |
| 人工智能 | artificial intelligence |
| 碳中和 | carbon neutrality |
| 春节 | the Spring Festival |
| 中秋节 | the Mid-Autumn Festival |
| 孔子 | Confucius |
| 儒家思想 | Confucianism |
| 京剧 | Peking Opera |
| 书法 | calligraphy |

## 万能句式（介绍文化题）

- …… 有着悠久的历史：... has a long history dating back to...
- …… 象征着…：... symbolizes... / stands for...
- …… 在人们生活中扮演重要角色：... plays an indispensable role in people's lives
- 随着……的发展：With the development of... / Along with...
- 不仅……而且……：Not only does it..., but it also...（倒装）

## 示例串写

> 剪纸是中国最古老的民间艺术之一，有着两千多年的历史。它不仅在节日装饰中扮演重要角色，还象征着人们对美好生活的向往。

> Paper cutting is one of the oldest folk arts in China, with a history of over two thousand years. Not only does it play an important role in festival decorations, but it also symbolizes people's yearning for a better life.
